mentions.name: Personal podcast and website launchpad
mentions.description: This project is a podcast with an associated website that the creator plans to use as the launchpad for their future ventures, as part of a 2025 goal to leave corporate employment and work for themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on launching a podcast and associated website which I hope to use as the launchpad for all my ventures going forward. 2025 is the year I ditch my corporate job and finally start working for myself.
